Let <MATH_0001> be a locally Noetherian scheme. Let <MATH_0002> be a scheme locally
of finite type over <MATH_0003>. Let <MATH_0004> be closed. Let <MATH_0005> be
a locally Noetherian formal algebraic space over <MATH_0006> such that
<MATH_0007> is locally of finite type over <MATH_0008>. Let <MATH_0009>
be an adic morphism of formal algebraic spaces over <MATH_0010>. Let <MATH_0011>
be a closed point such that <MATH_0012> is versal at <MATH_0013> (as in
Section <REF_0001>).
Then after replacing <MATH_0014> by an open neighbourhood of <MATH_0015> the
morphism <MATH_0016> is smooth (see proof).
